people.imagined: Singing the oldest planting song at the rice plot over the graves, hat pushed back, her voice carrying.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a flooded rice plot in a silvery dusk she sings the oldest planting song with her head thrown back and her mouth wide, her rice-straw hat pushed off her face and hanging by its cord. Face: most important, the pushed-back straw hat and the wide-open singing mouth. A round, brown, merry face, cheeks flushed; closed, laughing eyes; high, bright brows; a snub nose; white teeth. Hair: black, in two thick braids over the shoulders tied with yellow thread, a single slim dark-silver hairpin catching the light. Body: sturdy, strong, open-chested, her back arched, standing ankle-deep in the paddy water. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of black silk shot with faint storm-violet, two crossed collars, wide sleeves pushed up her forearms, the hem lifted and knotted at the knee; a narrow border of tiny silver raindrops at the cuffs, a black gauze rain-cape over the shoulders, a dark sash with one small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a bundle of green rice seedlings in the left hand, the right arm flung wide in song. A plain short slim sword with a faint green bloom on the steel, its grip wrapped in plaited rice-straw cord, a small round dark iron guard and a sprig of dried rice ears at the scabbard mouth, is slung across her back, its hilt above the left shoulder. Power: a few pale green and silver motes rise from the seedlings and drift around her singing mouth. Background: dark misty water, green shoots glowing faintly, low grave markers fading into pearl mist. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left, a silvery rim along her cheek and braids, the seedlings glowing like emeralds. Expression: joyful, loud and warm.

people.imagined: At the forge, hauling a chain-cup out of the quench, charcoal in his eyelashes. He lied to the Bell Test about his Metal.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim forge-cave lit by a glowing furnace-mouth he hauls a bronze cup on an iron hook out of a steaming quench trough, eyes narrowed, wary of the viewer. Face: most important, thick charcoal black clogging his eyelashes and rimming his eyes, and a shiny raised quench-burn across the back of his hand. A narrow, dark, sooty face; sly, bright, dark eyes; stubborn brows; a thin nose; a closed, mulish mouth. Hair: black, matted with soot and a few ash flakes, bound in a dark silk ribbon dark with sweat. Body: stocky, strong, forearms bare, leaning away from the heat with one shoulder raised against the steam. Clothing: a plain but graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back with copper wire and black with soot at the cuffs, a narrow silver lightning border, a black sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the iron hook in the right hand with a dripping bronze cup, the pink burn on the left hand. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain long straight sword, its grip wrapped in scorched cord gone black, a thick plain disc guard of unpolished forge iron still rough with scale, a scabbard of scorched pine, a quench-hook ring on the pommel. Power: a few thin white-silver sparks of Metal qi drift upward with the steam, and a hint of ember-red among them. Background: an orange forge mouth, curling steam, a rack of finished bronze cups glowing faintly red at their rims. Light: furnace-orange glow from the right, a cold spirit-light rim on the left. Expression: guarded, stubborn, a little sly.

people.imagined: Holding her tray of dried apricots, counting out one short, smiling sweetly. Apricot stains on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: in a lantern-lit market arcade at night she holds a wide flat tray of dried apricots at her waist and gives a sweet smile while one finger counts out the fruit, one short. Face: most important, the flat wooden tray crowded with orange dried apricots filling the lower frame, and her sleeves stained orange-yellow. A pretty, round, bright face; quick, shrewd, brown eyes with long curling lashes; arched brows; a small nose; a sweet, small, wide smile with a faint dimple in the left cheek. Hair: black, in a high bun with a fresh apricot flower and a slim silver hairpin. Body: slim, quick and neat, holding herself very straight, the tray at a precise level, one hip cocked. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, wide sleeves whose cuffs are stained apricot-orange, a border of tiny silver raindrops, a black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: both hands on the tray, the right forefinger tapping a small pile of five. A plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in cord the colour of dried apricot, a plain iron ring guard, a scabbard of grey lacquer with an apricot stain at the mouth and a polished apricot-stone bead at the pommel, is slung across the back, its hilt above the right shoulder. Power: faint motes of silver and amber float over the fruit like drifting pollen. Background: blurred stall, strings of dried apricot slices and coloured paper charms swaying, soft mist and lanterns. Light: warm gold lantern-glow from the upper left makes each piece of fruit glisten like amber, a pale moon rim on her hair. Expression: sweetly innocent, quick, avid.

people.imagined: Night beside a rain-chain, counting each drop aloud with his lips. He can count all night and not lose his place.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a hanging bronze rain-chain he stands in perfect stillness, lips moving silently to the rhythm of the falling drops, counting; he can count all night and never lose his place. Face: most important, lips parted and moving in time with the drops, eyes unfocused. A long, calm, pale, patient face; half-closed dark serene eyes with long still lashes; level brows; a straight nose; a small mouth carrying the shape of a hum. Hair: black, in a plain knot at the nape held by a slim dark-silver pin. Body: lean, still, straight-backed, heels together, arms loose, a plumb-line of attention. Clothing: a clean, graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, wide quiet sleeves, a faint silver raindrop border, a black gauze rain-cloak falling in long folds, a black sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, one finger counting; beside him a bronze chain of small cups with water falling from one to the next, each drop a bright point, one caught mid-air. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain long straight sword, its grip wrapped in grey hemp cord laid in even counted turns, a plain oval guard of dull steel, a scabbard of black oiled wood, a hollowed drip-stone bead on a thread at the pommel. Power: tiny pale silver and earth-gold motes hang in the air with the drops, rising and falling in his count. Background: deep blue night, wet stone, mist, a faint lantern. Light: blue moonlight and a small lantern glow from the left glinting on the drops, a thin silver rim on his profile. Expression: patient and humble, entranced, the absorbed face of a boy hearing something no one else hears.

people.imagined: A sunny day, carrying someone's gold pan home, trusting and friendly, no singed hair on him. His sister has the lightning, he has none.
people.subject: The moment: in bright morning light on a mist-washed stream bank he smiles openly as he carries a big shallow wooden gold pan home with both hands, glad to help; his sister has the lightning, he has none. Face: most important, fine gold flecks glittering on every fingernail of the hands holding the pan. A round, trusting, freckled face, cheeks pink; wide bright brown eyes; arched brows; a snub nose; a wide easy smile with a faint dimple in the left cheek and front teeth a little too big. Hair: black and neat, without a singed hair, tied with a green thread, a cowlick standing up at the crown, the fringe cut short and uneven by a sister's shears. Body: small, sturdy, light, walking with a bounce, elbows out, shoulders square with the effort of being careful. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, fresh and clean, crossed collars, a narrow silver lightning border at the cuffs, a short black gauze rain-cape, a black sash hung with one small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a shallow wooden panning dish held in both hands, glittering with a few yellow flecks. A plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in black cord with gold dust glinting in the weave, a plain steel guard with a chisel-flat edge and a scabbard of dark horn-brown wood, is slung across the back, its hilt above the left shoulder. Power: a few faint motes of gold and pale silver drift from the wet flecks and wink like tiny stars. Background: a pearly stream bank dissolving into mist, the soft shapes of a drill yard. Light: bright silvery morning light from the upper left, soft rim on his hair, the wet gold winking like coins. Expression: open, friendly, trusting.

people.imagined: Sitting on her packed bag in a fisher's hat indoors, a letter half written. She has packed and unpacked it every feast day.
people.subject: The moment: in a small quiet room washed with pale moonlight she sits on her half-packed bag, a wide conical fisher's hat still on her head, a half-written letter under the knot, staring into the distance; she has packed and unpacked it every feast day. Face: most important, the big conical straw fisher's hat worn indoors, its brim shading her face, and the packed cloth bag on her knees. A narrow, restless, tan face; dark, longing eyes looking away; thin arched brows; a small straight nose with a little pink at the tip; a thin mouth pressed in doubt; a faint red line along the jaw where the hat cord lies. Hair: black, in a loose tail over one shoulder, a slim dark-silver pin at the nape. Body: slim, slouched forward. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, crossed collars, sleeves a little short for her wrists, a narrow silver raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: both hands on the knotted bundle, a half-folded letter tucked under the knot. Past the left shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Power: a faint blue mist of Water qi gathers at her feet and curls round the bag. Background: a small plain room, a narrow bed, a window of silver night, the corner of the letter glowing white. Light: soft moonlight through the window from the upper left laying a thin pale square at her feet, a cool rim on her cheek. Expression: longing, undecided, honest.

people.imagined: Showing the star-shaped birthmark under his ear to a visitor, proclaiming the day's lucky colour, sure the thunder means something.
people.subject: The moment: on a stone stair under a pearl-grey sky he turns his head to show a star-shaped birthmark under his ear to a visitor, a proud smirk on his face, sure the thunder means something and that the day's lucky colour is yellow. Face: most important, a clear dark-red five-pointed star birthmark under his left ear, shown by his turned head. A sharp, handsome, proud face; bright arrogant brown eyes; high arched brows thin and sharply drawn; a straight nose lifted slightly with a trace of face-powder on it; a cocky smile. Hair: black, in a high topknot bound by a bright yellow ribbon and a dark-silver hairpin. Body: lean and strutting, shoulders back, chest out like a peacock. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk shot with storm-violet, the collar left a little open, two crossed collars, wide sleeves with silver lightning embroidery at the cuffs, a yellow cord at the wrist, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: one hand tilts his jaw to show the mark; the other rests on the hilt of a plain slim sword at his hip. Power: a few bright silver sparks of Metal qi flicker along his shoulders, as if the day's thunder agreed with him. Background: a stone stair, and on it a thin young woman in a dark sleeve who stands aside with a stiff set face, out of focus, mist behind. Light: bright cool spirit-light from the upper left, clean on the skin and the red mark, a silver rim along the jaw. Expression: proud and utterly sure of himself, the smirk of a boy who has decided what the lucky colour is and expects agreement.

people.imagined: Standing on stone as if in a ricefield, steady, waiting to hear whether she is to be sent to the terraces. Tenant-farmer's brown forearms.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a wet stone stair in drifting mist, feet apart, hands folded in front of her as if still in a rice paddy, calm and honest, waiting to hear whether she will be sent to the terraces. Face: most important, her bare forearms below rolled sleeves, deeply browned and sinewy, a tenant-farmer's, crossed in the lower frame. A broad, plain, sun-browned face; calm, clear, dark eyes; straight dark brows; a flat nose; a wide patient mouth; sun-darkened cheekbones and a thin white line at the hairline where her hat usually sits. Hair: black, tied in a plain tail with a straw cord and a slim dark-silver pin, the ends bleached lighter by the sun. Body: stocky and solid, planted wide. Clothing: a clean, graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, crossed collars, wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, a thin silver raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: both brown forearms crossed in front of her; a small straw hat hangs on a cord at her back. A plain straight double-edged sword in a green-stained scabbard is slung across the back, its dark wood guard and bark-brown cord grip above the right shoulder. Power: a few pale green and blue motes of Wood and Water qi rise from the wet stone around her ankles. Background: a grey stone stair, wet rice terraces beyond glowing faintly green, soft mist. Light: broad, soft, even moonlit light from the upper left that shows every honest line of her face, a pearly rim on her shoulder. Expression: calm and patient, the open look of someone who has never learned to hide what she thinks.

people.imagined: By the outer gate's stoves, a stove-poker on his shoulder, sleepy and smiling. He wants nothing more.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone kitchen lit by glowing stove mouths he leans on a stove with an iron poker over his shoulder, half asleep and smiling, wanting nothing more. Face: most important, an iron stove-poker with its tip glowing dull red resting over his shoulder, and a sleepy contented smile. A round, sleepy, soot-smudged face; half-closed, warm brown eyes with heavy lids; soft low brows; a blunt nose; a lazy smile with a dimple at its corner; a faint ash smudge on one cheek. Hair: black, a ruffled mess with a flake of ash on top, pushed up on one side as if he has just woken, a slim dark-silver pin barely holding it. Body: round, comfortable, slouched, his cheek resting loose against the poker. Clothing: a plain but graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, dusted with ash but whole, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a narrow silver lightning border at the cuffs, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the poker held lightly in one hand over his shoulder, the other scratching his neck; a short plain sword hangs at his belt in a dark scabbard with a rust-red cord. Power: warm embers of red Fire qi drift up from the stove mouth and settle round him like fireflies. Background: a stone kitchen, a row of iron kettles above the stove, a bundle of kindling against the wall, a kettle steaming. Light: warm orange glow from the right and below, a faint cold moon rim from the high window on the left. Expression: the contentment of a man who has found the warmest corner of the world and means to stay in it.

people.imagined: Waiting for a storm, clacking an iron bracelet against a copper one, impatient, sure her Fire and Metal will meet.
people.subject: The moment: under a dark purple storm sky she waits for the lightning with her arms crossed, clacking an iron bracelet against a copper one on her wrist, looking up, impatient and sure her Fire and Metal will meet. Face: most important, an iron bracelet and a copper bracelet side by side on her bare left wrist, dull iron against bright copper. A strong, sharp, brave, sun-brown face; bright, fierce, amber eyes with singed-short lashes; thick arched brows; a straight nose; a firm impatient mouth with a thin scar nicking the left corner of the upper lip. Hair: black, in a thick high tail tied with a red cord and a dark-silver hairpin. Body: lean, strong and restless, weight on one foot, one hip pushed out, the very picture of waiting. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, sleeves rolled to the elbow, crossed collars with silver lightning embroidery, a short black gauze rain-cloak, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the iron and copper bands clacked together. A plain short slim sword in a red-brown scabbard is slung across the back, its copper guard and rust-red cord grip above the right shoulder. Power: tiny red embers and silver sparks gather round her wrist and jump between the two bracelets. Background: a purple storm sky, the thin smoke of a charcoal-burner's kiln. Light: cold storm light from the upper left, a far lightning flicker making the bracelets flash white for an instant, a violet rim on her cheek. Expression: impatient and bold, a hopeful, challenging lift of the chin toward the sky.

people.imagined: In the coast house counting room, a ledger-ruler tucked behind her ear, salt in her eyebrows, keeping two sets of books.
people.subject: The moment: in the counting room of a coast house, lit by cool silver sea-light, she looks up from her desk with a careful, neutral face, a long wooden ruler tucked behind her ear, keeping two sets of books. Face: most important, a long flat wooden ruler behind her right ear and white salt crystals caught in her eyebrows. A neat, thin, sallow face; careful light grey eyes; salt-white brows; a small nose; a tidy closed mouth held deliberately blank. Hair: dark brown, in a flat bun held by a hair-stick of bleached driftwood with a trace of white salt, beside a slim dark-silver pin. Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, sitting upright with elbows in, knees together under the desk. Clothing: an immaculate graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a silver wave-and-raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cape with salt dried on its hem, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: an ink brush held upright in the right hand, the left resting on two thick books on the desk. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword with a faint damp sheen, its grip wrapped in salt-stiffened grey twine, a flat bar guard with a notch, a scabbard of black oilskin over wood whitened with salt at the seams, a small cork float on a line at the pommel. Power: a thin blue-silver mist of Water qi hangs above the ledgers like sea haze. Background: shelves of ledgers in grey covers each tied with a different coloured cord, a window with a pale sea and gulls. Light: cool moonlit sea-glow from the upper left, a glint of salt in the brows and on the hem. Expression: careful and bland, a face smoothed over with deliberate blankness, hiding.

people.imagined: At the mine, pocket full of pebbles shaped like faces; his honest face tells you the rest.
people.subject: The moment: at a mine mouth in misty rain he pats a bulging pocket that clicks and holds out one pebble toward the viewer, his face transparent, honest and guilty, like a boy caught. Face: most important, the bulging pocket of pale pebbles and, in his outstretched palm, one pebble with natural eye-holes and a mouth-line like a tiny face. A mild, open, round face; wide honest brown eyes; light upturned brows; a short nose; a worried gentle mouth, a little open to confess; a smear of pale clay on the left cheek and ears red with nerves. Hair: black and tousled, a pebble caught in it, a slim dark-silver pin hanging slack. Body: slight and round-shouldered, weight on both heels, arms a little out from his sides. Clothing: a clean, graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, dusty at the hem from the mine, crossed collars, a narrow silver raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell; one pocket is stitched larger than the other. Hands and objects: the right palm holds the face-like pebble; the left pats the pocket. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in dark hemp, a flat teardrop guard of grey iron, a scabbard of dark leather bulging at the mouth where a pebble is jammed, a face-shaped pebble wired to the strap. Power: faint silver and amber motes shimmer over the pebbles in his hand like dust in moonlight. Background: a rainy mine entrance of dark timber, a pile of rocks, pale mist. Light: soft moonlit grey light from the upper left, a thin film of light on the wet pebbles giving each a tiny shine. Expression: a guilty flinch he cannot hide, the mouth half open as if about to confess everything.

people.imagined: Bowing exactly a hand's depth to an elder, counting steps. He wants the Hall of Rules and knows every rule.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the doorway of a stern hall he gives an exact bow, back flat, head lowered a hand's depth, then looks up, counting his steps; he wants the Hall of Rules and knows every rule. Face: most important, the precisely measured bow of the head and the perfectly flat back. A narrow, pale, correct face; calm, precise dark eyes; level even brows; a straight nose; a flat closed mouth; a faint pale line from a cap-string across the forehead. Hair: black, combed flat and tied in a tight small knot in a square wrap of black thread, held by a dark-silver pin, not a hair out of place. Body: thin, upright and rigid. Clothing: a pressed, immaculate graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, not one crease in the two crossed collars, wide sleeves hanging dead straight, a silver raindrop border in exact rows, a black gauze rain-cape folded in exact thirds over one arm, a black sash tied square with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: both hands pressed flat on his thighs, a wooden counting-bead string at his belt. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain slim jian, its grip wrapped in neat grey silk cord in exactly even turns, a thin round guard, a scabbard of grey lacquered wood hung dead straight, one small grey knot centred on the pommel. Power: a few precise pale silver and earth-gold motes hang in a straight line beside him. Background: the plain doorway of a stern hall, a water clock dripping in the shadow, cool mist. Light: a flat white spirit-light from the doorway showing every line of his posture, a thin silver rim, no soft shadow. Expression: correct and still, serious, the faint tension of a boy who fears only that he has miscounted.

people.imagined: Sweeping the old tower's stair, wet broom, wet sleeves, a damp pigtail dripping down her back.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping a wet stair of the old tower in the silver mist, she pauses with the broom and looks up with a gentle, devout, trusting smile. Face: most important, a damp pigtail dripping water down her back and a wet broom of bound twigs held in both hands. A small, round, soft, dewy face; large calm dark eyes; fine brows; a small nose; a gentle smile; a wet strand clinging to her cheek and neck. Hair: black, in a long wet braid tied with a green ribbon dark with water, a slim dark-silver pin at the crown. Body: small, thin, light, narrow shoulders a little bowed from sweeping, feet together, toes slightly turned in. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, wet and dark at the cuffs and hem, two crossed collars, sleeves knotted up above the elbow with twine, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: both hands on the long twig broom, water drops falling from the bristles. A plain short slim sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung across the back, its pewter guard and pale blue cord grip above the left shoulder. Power: a faint blue-white mist of Water qi rises from the wet stone and rings her head like a pale halo. Background: a grey old stone stair, a bronze chain dripping, a misty lake path glowing silver. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left, droplets glittering on the broom's twigs, a pearl rim on her cheek. Expression: a gentle, trusting smile, eyes upturned and soft.

people.imagined: One pace behind his master, copying his limp, looking at the red names on a sleeve and wanting to ask.
people.subject: The moment: in a rainy yard of wet flagstones he walks half-turned one pace behind his master, one leg dragging in imitation of the master's limp, looking at the red names on a sleeve out of frame and wanting to ask. Face: most important, the deliberately copied limping stride, one shoulder dropped, and an eager, hungry look. A square, hot, young face; bright, hungry dark eyes; thick intense brows; a short nose; a tight mouth; a thin pale scar nicking the chin and sweat on the upper lip. Hair: black, in a hard high topknot copying a duellist's, held by a black iron hairpin too large for him with a small notch bent in it. Body: stocky, strong, a forced swagger, the left shoulder dipping with each step and the left leg dragging a little. Clothing: a clean, graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, crossed collars, wide sleeves, a silver lightning border, one tiny red thread stitched on his own sleeve, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the right hand on a plain sword hilt at his hip; the left raised to point at a sleeve. Power: a few pale silver sparks of Metal qi crackle at his hungry fingertips. Background: a rainy yard, the back of a tall man in a black cloak blurred and tall in the mist. Light: cold silver light from the upper left, a drizzle-sheen along the wet flagstones showing his stiff figure in sharp outline, a faint violet rim. Expression: eager, ambitious, avid.

people.imagined: Weaving a basket with quick fingers, apricot sash on, holding the best fruit back for a buyer who pays double. She means to wait for her Metal.
people.subject: The moment: weaving a basket in a dim fruit stall with quick fingers, glancing sideways with a small secret smile, apricots hidden under a cloth at her side; she means to hold the best fruit back for the buyer who pays double and to wait for her Metal. Face: most important, an apricot-orange silk sash tied bright at her waist, and fingers that are a blur of weaving. A small, clever, round face; sharp, pale brown eyes in a sideways glance; thin arched brows; a small nose with a dusting of freckles and a tiny crease between the brows; a small tight patient smile. Hair: dark brown, in a neat coil held by a wooden pin and a slim dark-silver one. Body: small, slim, neat, sitting with knees together and back straight, patient as a cat at a mouse-hole. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a silver raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cape, the apricot-orange silk sash with a small bronze bell, a wicker basket on her lap. Hands and objects: both hands weaving thin pale-green willow strips; a few ripe apricots under a cloth beside her. A plain short slim sword with a faint violet gleam in the edge, its grip wrapped in plaited pale-straw cane in a basket weave, a small round iron guard, a scabbard of black wood wrapped in wicker, and a short apricot-thread tassel is slung across the back, its hilt above the left shoulder. Power: pale silver motes of Metal qi drift round the sword hilt, with one thin violet thread of lightning curling among them. Background: a dim stall with baskets and hanging fruit, blue mist. Light: a band of warm gold light slanting through the stall front onto the wicker, a cool moon rim on her hair. Expression: patient, calculating, secretive.

people.imagined: Wearing a dented old captain's helmet as a rain-pot at the gate, honest and stubborn. His family kept the helmet and nothing else.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a wooden gate in falling rain, solemn, a dented old captain's helmet on his head, water running off its crown; his family kept the helmet and nothing else. Face: most important, the dented old iron helmet with a flat crest, a deep dent on one side and rust at the rim, and a thin rust-streak running down his temple like a tear. A strong, square, boyish, honest face; steady, dark, brave eyes; thick brows; a broad nose; a firm closed mouth with a faint red-brown fuzz on the lip and a cleft in the chin. Hair: red-brown, wet, poking out under the helmet. Body: sturdy, square-shouldered, heels together, the posture of a boy told his ancestor's name many times. Clothing: a clean graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, the sleeves a little short and showing thin wrists, a narrow silver raindrop border, a black gauze rain-cloak, a dark sash with a small bronze bell, a strip of red cloth tied round the left forearm. Hands and objects: both hands hold a plain sword upright before him, its point down, rain collecting in the helmet's dent. Power: a faint blue-white mist of Water qi and a few silver motes cling to the wet blade. Background: a grey wooden gate, falling rain lit softly silver, a blurred path. Light: cool moonlit light from the upper left sliding off the wet iron of the helmet and gleaming on the sword hilt. Expression: a solemn, proud set to the mouth with the chin lifted under the dented helm, eyes straight ahead, rain running down his face.

people.imagined: Panning the drill ground for gold dust, the pan-hand trembling, making a smaller boy carry the pan home.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on his heels over a flat pan of wet sand on a drill ground, a trembling hand making the sand shiver, a few gold specks shining in it, eyes greedily bright. Face: most important, the shallow pan of wet sand with bright gold specks held in his shaking hand, and fine gold dust under every nail. A sly, round, sunburnt face; shiny, quick, light-brown eyes; thin brows; a button nose; a half-open eager mouth with a dimple even in the greedy half-smile; a smear of grey mud on the chin. Hair: sandy brown, a messy fringe, a plain dark-silver pin. Body: plump, loose, hunched with his elbows on his knees, the belly spilling slightly over the sash. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, muddy at the knees, the hem and sleeves stiff with dried mud, crossed collars, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell and a small cloth bag tied in it, bulging with something heavy. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the pan, the left points with gold-dust nails at a speck. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in fine pale sand-coloured cord, a small guard with gold dust in its pits, a scabbard of dun hide that glitters faintly, a pinch of gold dust sealed in a wax pill on the pommel cord. Power: pale silver and gold motes lift from the sand and wink around his fingertips. Background: a wet drill yard in blue mist, puddles, a few blurred figures. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a thin white shaft through a gap in the cloud lighting a speck of gold like a star. Expression: eyes bright with want under a lowered head, a sly smirk that says the gold is already his.

people.imagined: A beat after a joke, he grins, a chipped front tooth. At the front of every climb.
people.subject: The moment: a slow, late grin spreads across his face a beat after a joke, a chipped front tooth showing; he is always at the front of every climb. Face: most important, one chipped front tooth, a half-moon gone from its corner, in a broad late grin. A big, broad, plain, red-cheeked face; small loyal brown eyes; thick brows; a wide flat nose; thick, slightly cauliflowered ears; a smile lingering at the corner of the mouth as if the joke were still being turned over. Hair: black, cropped dense, with a small bald spot at the crown where a rope once burned it. Body: enormous shoulders and a thick neck as wide as his head, the trapezius rising in two steep slopes to his ears, the strongest boy of his year. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, drawn tight across the shoulders, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a silver lightning border, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a thick iron chain link with a bite mark in it in the right hand; the left hand scratches his head. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip thick and bound in black leather, a heavy squared iron cross guard with one arm bent by a blow, a scabbard of pitch-black oak banded in iron, a bent chain link on a cord, a link he once bit through. Power: thick pale silver Metal qi hangs round his shoulders in slow, heavy wisps. Background: a grey drill yard in pearl mist, a drum post. Light: soft silver light from the upper left giving the chain link a dull shine, a faint violet rim. Expression: slow, loyal and cheerful, an easy unhurried good humour.

people.imagined: A miner's daughter, a thunder-glass bead swinging at her neck, due to walk into the inner gate this spring and worshipping Khúc Thanh Điện.
people.subject: The moment: in front of a mine yard with arms folded and chin lifted, a violet glass bead swinging at her neck, a miner's daughter confident that this spring she walks into the inner gate, worshipping Khúc Thanh Điện. Face: most important, a violet thunder-glass bead on a cord swinging against her chest, and thick miner's wrists below the crossed arms. A strong, bright, tanned face; keen dark ambitious eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; a wide confident smile with a tiny gap between the front teeth; freckles over her cheeks and nose. Hair: black, in a high tail as thick as a rope tied with a violet cord and a dark-silver hairpin, a few short curls round the ears. Body: broad-shouldered, feet wide and weight low, a miner's solid stance. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk shot with storm-violet, sleeves rolled to the elbow, two crossed collars with silver lightning embroidery, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: arms crossed, the bead hanging from its cord. A plain short slim sword with a faint violet gleam in the edge, its grip wrapped in black cord, a plain ring guard, a scabbard of grey-black lacquer, a loop of braided miner's lamp-wick over the guard, is slung across the back, its hilt above the right shoulder. Power: tiny violet sparks of Thunder qi crawl along the bead and the sword's edge, with pale silver wisps beneath. Background: a mine yard with violet crystals piled in a cart, a grey-blue sky, mist. Light: bright cool spirit-light from the upper left, a glint of violet running along each thunder-glass crystal and lighting the bead at her neck. Expression: bright with the eager certainty of someone who has already pictured herself a step higher.

people.imagined: Walking behind his uncle along the ridge with the drumstick's case strapped across his back like a bow. He has counted where it hums.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a misty ridge a pace behind an unseen uncle, a long lacquered case strapped diagonally across his back like a bow, head cocked and hand lifted to his ear, listening to a hum; he has counted where it hums. Face: most important, the long black lacquered drumstick case strapped across his back, rising over one shoulder, and the head cocked to listen. A quiet, mild, narrow face; humble, attentive dark eyes with pale lashes; level brows; a straight nose; a small patient mouth, lips thin and often moving as if counting; a small mole below the right eye. Hair: black, tied in a short neat knot with a strip of brown cloth and a dark-silver pin, the nape showing a pale scar from a childhood fall. Body: lean, upright, steady, shoulders level, the case riding squarely on his spine. Clothing: a clean graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a silver raindrop border, a black gauze rain-cloak, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted by his ear; the strap crossing his chest. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword, its grip wrapped in oiled gut strip, a narrow plain bar guard, a scabbard of black lacquered leather hung beside the drumstick case, a scrap of drumskin tied at the pommel. Power: faint silver ripples of Metal qi, like the rings of a struck bell, spread through the mist near his ear. Background: a misty ridge path, pines, a faint far flash. Light: soft cool moonlight from the upper left and thin white mist making the dark case gleam like wet lacquer. Expression: head cocked, eyes lifted, lips slightly open, a humble look of listening to something far off.

people.imagined: Beneath the founder's rain-chain at the Rain Tower, oiling the nine bronze cups, polishing the cup at her own neck as she talks. She will sit beneath it with her sword if anyone comes to take it down.
people.subject: The moment: standing beneath the founder's long bronze rain-chain of nine cups at the Rain Tower, one hand polishing the bronze cup at her own neck with a cloth while she looks firmly at the viewer; she will sit beneath it with her sword if anyone comes to take it down. Face: most important, the small bronze rain-cup hung at her throat on a cord, rubbed bright, and above her the hanging chain of nine cups. A square, firm, fair-brown face; steady, dark, defiant eyes; straight dark brows; a short straight nose; a firm closed mouth. Hair: black, in a tight high bun crowned with a small silver coronet of raindrops and a bronze pin. Body: sturdy, straight, planted, feet a shoulder-width apart and spine like a drawn bow. Clothing: layered robes of deep black brocade and storm-violet silk, three crossed collars, wide sleeves embroidered in silver thread with lightning and falling rain, a long black oiled-silk over-robe oiled to a gloss that falls in rain-straight folds, a high collar, a black sash hung with a bronze bell and a violet jade pendant. Hands and objects: a small cloth in the right hand rubbing the cup at her neck; the left hand rests on the hilt of a plain sword at her hip; behind her the chain of nine bronze cups hanging from the eaves. Power: a soft aura of white-silver Metal qi with ember-red threads of Fire shimmers round her shoulders, and the nine cups hum with faint light. Background: grey tower eaves, silver rain, a misty hill. Light: pale spirit-light falling through the eaves picking out each of the nine bronze cups in turn, a bright silver rim on her jaw. Expression: firm, loyal, unyielding.

people.imagined: Weighing grain in the cistern yard, a scale-beam tattooed on his wrist, grain dust in the creases of his neck, taking the tenants' seed barley by the book.
people.subject: The moment: in a cistern yard in soft rain he lifts one wrist to show a tattoo and looks calmly at the viewer, weighing the tenants' seed barley by the book. Face: most important, a small black scale-beam tattoo on the inside of his left wrist, plain and bold as he rests it on the scale. A round, smooth, comfortable face; calm, dull, grey-brown eyes; neat brows; a small nose; a tidy closed neutral mouth; a faint lengthwise crease in each cheek, grain dust in the creases of the neck and a drop of sweat at the temple. Hair: dark, thinning, combed flat, a grey streak on the left, the topknot held with a black wooden pin beside a small silver crown-clasp. Body: stout, soft, settled, feet together and belly forward, hands never far from the scale. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, wide grain-dusted cuffs embroidered with silver raindrops and scale-beams, a long black over-robe neat in rain-straight folds, a black sash hung with a bronze bell and a grey jade weight. Hands and objects: the left wrist rests on a wooden balance with two pans, one holding barley; the right hand holds a measuring scoop. Power: a soft haze of blue-white Water qi and pale silver Metal qi drifts round his shoulders. Background: sacks of barley stacked, a stone cistern, soft silver rain. Light: soft moonlit grey from the upper left stirring the grain dust into gold motes that hang about him. Expression: bland and correct, a face that will not give.

people.imagined: At the oars on the lake, rowing a burial out to the withered lotus, her hands never shaking, a mourning-white cord at her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: rowing across a misty lake with steady oars, her eyes on the far withered lotus, a white mourning cord at her wrist; she rows a burial out and her hands never shake. Face: most important, a white mourning cord knotted round her left wrist, bright against the grey. A solemn, calm, pale face; dark, steady, grieving eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed quiet mouth; wet strands clinging to her cheek and a small pale scar at the chin. Hair: black, tied back plainly, a white cord wound twice round the knot with its two ends stirring at her nape, a slim silver hairpin. Body: strong, balanced at the oars, shoulders level, sitting upright on the thwart, her back touching nothing. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, sleeves pushed up over strong forearms, a long black over-robe with a border of silver waves and raindrops, a dark sash hung with a bronze bell and a white jade bead. Hands and objects: both hands round the wooden oar handles, the palms thick with callus, perfectly steady. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with a faint damp bloom on the steel, its grip wrapped in wet-darkened oar-lashing hemp, a flat guard shaped like a tiny oar-blade of tarnished iron, a scabbard of dark green-black lotus-leaf lacquer, a dried lotus seed on the pommel cord. Power: a soft aura of pale silver Metal qi with an earth-gold edge, and thin blue mist rising from the lake round the boat. Background: a grey lake, withered pale lotus leaves, a faint shape of a long bundle in the boat. Light: silver moonlight on the water from the upper left, a gleam on the wet oar blades. Expression: grave, steady, reverent.

people.imagined: Walking along the Iron Rain chain, tapping each link with a hammer, listening for the one that rings wrong.
people.subject: The moment: bending from the waist along a long iron chain on a misty ridge, he taps a link with a small hammer, head cocked, listening for the one that rings wrong. Face: most important, the small hammer raised to tap an iron chain link and his ear turned toward the chain. A thin, leathery, long face, grey with age and soot; narrow, careful, pale eyes; heavy grey brows; a long nose; a thin patient mouth; soot in the deep creases of the forehead, white stubble at the chin and black at the cheek. Hair: iron-grey, in a thin short tail, a dark cloth bound round the head under a plain silver crown-clasp. Body: lean, bent and long-armed, one hand on his knee, patient as a heron. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, black cuffs scorched at the hem and held back with copper wire, a long black over-robe with silver lightning and raindrop borders, a dark sash hung with a bronze bell and a smoky jade pendant; a smith's wear honestly shown on the silk, no apron. Hands and objects: a small iron hammer in the right hand; the left grips a thick iron chain running out of the frame. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wound in fine drawn bronze wire of his own making, a heavy square guard of dark iron, a scabbard of black iron-bound oak, a single chain link that rings against the guard when he walks. Power: a soft aura of white-silver Metal qi with a faint earth-gold edge pools round the hammer and the link. Background: a long iron chain running along a ridge into mist under a dark sky. Light: cold moonlit sheen along the links ending in a point of white where the hammer is about to fall, a pale rim on his brow. Expression: attentive and patient, the unhurried look of a man listening.

people.imagined: Night in the soul vaults, hair pinned up with a wick-trimmer, owl-wide pupils, knowing each lamp by its flicker.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim vault at night, among rows of tiny glowing lamps, she looks toward one flickering flame with owl-wide pupils, a wick-trimmer pinned through her hair; she knows each lamp by its flicker. Face: most important, pupils so enormous they almost fill the irises like an owl's, and a pair of small brass wick-trimming scissors thrust through her hair-knot. A pale, thin, narrow face; thin brows; a small straight nose; a soft tired mouth; fine lines from nose to mouth corners that speak of late nights, short straight lashes. Hair: black, piled in a knot under a small silver coronet, the brass scissors pinned in. Body: slight, thin, perfectly still, weight on the left foot and the right foot turned out, as if she were a lamp stand herself. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, ink-dark cuffs, a long black over-robe with silver lightning and flame-flicker embroidery, a dark sash with a leather case of spare wicks, a bronze bell and a smoky jade pendant. Hands and objects: a small lamp with a wavering flame held at chest height in both hands, the fingertips of the right hand black with wick soot; behind her shelves of tiny lamps in rows. Power: a soft aura of white-silver Metal qi with ember-red threads of Fire, flickering in time with the lamp. Background: a dim vault of rows of small lamps, each a point of warm light in deep shadow. Light: warm trembling lamplight, deep shadow, the flame reflected twice in each wide pupil, a cold violet rim on her hair. Expression: watchful, tired, haunted.

people.imagined: Rolling dice in a harbour tavern, losing carefully with an easy smile, a tooth missing, listening to the crews.
people.subject: The moment: in a smoky harbour tavern he throws two white dice with an easy loser's smile, a front tooth missing, ears alert to the crews around him; he loses carefully and listens. Face: most important, a missing front tooth showing as a dark gap in an easy friendly smile, and callus-rough fingertips. A friendly, open, craggy face; twinkling bright brown eyes, a little too attentive; loose brows with a small notch cut in one by an old dice-quarrel; a crooked nose; a day's grey stubble. Hair: black, tousled, a twist of red thread binding the tail, a stray lock over one eye, a small gold ring in one ear. Body: loose, relaxed, slouched with one elbow on the table, ready to laugh at his own bad luck. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze worn loose with an open collar, three crossed collars, wide sleeves, a long black over-robe with silver wave and raindrop borders, a dark sash hung with a bronze bell and a small blue jade fish. Hands and objects: the right hand open, releasing two white dice in the air; the left fingertips rough with dice. A well-made narrow straight sword with no obvious wear, its grip covered in soft grey eel-skin, a slim bar guard worn bare, a scabbard of dark fish-oiled leather, a small bone die with the six worn flat tied at the pommel, is slung across the back, its hilt above the right shoulder. Power: soft blue-white Water qi and pale silver motes drift round his open hand like smoke in the lamplight. Background: a smoky tavern, blurred sailors, a hanging lamp. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left throwing a swinging glow on the dice that tumble like small white moons, a cool blue rim from the doorway. Expression: easy, cheerful, listening.

people.imagined: Reading a charge in the dark by heart, eyes half closed, his voice lower than the water clock. He adds or drops a clause as the clock drips.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark hall he recites a charge by heart with his eyes half closed, mouth barely moving, a water clock dripping beside him; he adds or drops a clause as the clock drips. Face: most important, eyes half closed to slits and lips barely moving, a voice you can see being very low. A long, grey, solemn face, deeply lined; heavy-lidded eyes with the skin around them thin and bluish; thick grey brows; a long nose; a long thin still mouth; a pointed grey beard. Hair: grey, in a severe topknot under a small black cap with a silver clasp, the temples combed in hard lines. Body: tall, thin, upright, stiff as a post, shoulders level, hands clasped low before his belt. Clothing: layered robes of black brocade and storm-violet silk, three crossed collars with a stiff high outer collar of fine cloth, wide sleeves embroidered in silver thread with lightning and raindrops, a long black over-robe in rain-straight folds, a black sash hung with a bronze bell and a black jade tablet. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, empty; a small water clock dripping in the background. Power: a soft aura of cold silver Metal qi with a thin earth-gold edge steadies round him, stilled like frost. Background: a dark hall, a single lamp, the water clock. Light: dim cold spirit-light from the lower left, deep shadow, the drip of the clock throwing a small ripple of reflected light on the wall behind his shoulder. Expression: solemn, remote, unreadable.

people.imagined: On the storm climb, rain streaming, calves like rope, a face nothing bothers. He kept his pace when a boy's ankle broke.
people.subject: The moment: climbing in a storm, mid-stride, rain streaming down an impassive face; he kept his pace when a boy's ankle broke. Face: most important, rain streaming down a calm, unbothered face, and below it at the frame edge the rope-hard calves in a hitched-up robe. A long, lean, weathered face; flat, calm dark eyes; level brows; a long nose; a mouth like a closed door; a line of grey mud along the jaw and high, sharp cheekbones. Hair: black, plastered flat, tied in a short tail with a twist of sodden cord and a dark-silver pin, strands across the neck. Body: lean, rangy, rope-muscled. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze hitched up for the climb, three crossed collars, a long black over-robe flapping in the wind with a silver lightning border, a dark sash hung with a bronze bell and a violet jade bead. Hands and objects: a coil of wet rope over the left shoulder and a rope in the right hand; the left arm swinging as in a climb; each hand wrapped in grey cloth, the knuckles bare. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip wrapped in pitch-black weather-proofed cord, a small plain cross guard of iron, a scabbard of black lacquered cypress strapped twice to the back with a pale scar of stripped lacquer where lightning ran along it. Power: a hard aura of white-silver Metal qi hugs his body, and thin violet lightning crawls over the wet scabbard. Background: a steep wet peak path and a roaring storm sky. Light: cold white storm light from the upper left, rain lines flashing past a livid sky, each lightning pulse showing his set jaw in hard edges. Expression: impassive, steady, unbothered.

people.imagined: At the market weighing stall, a bone abacus at her belt, a bracelet of weights chiming. She pockets the copper tip and would like it noticed she took up the abacus.
people.subject: The moment: at a night-market weighing stall she shakes one wrist so a bracelet of tiny bronze weights chimes, eyes on the viewer; she pockets the copper tip and would like it noticed that she took up the abacus. Face: most important, a bracelet of many tiny bronze weights on her wrist, shaken so they chime, and a bone abacus at her belt. A sharp, handsome, brown face; bright appraising dark eyes; sharply arched brows; a straight nose with a tiny gold stud at the left nostril; a thin pleased mouth with a small smirk and a touch of rouge. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot with a bone comb, a silver coronet of small coins, and silver hairpins. Body: slim, straight, quick, one hip cocked, chin lifted like a seller of fine goods. Clothing: layered robes of black brocade and storm-violet silk, three crossed collars edged with a thin line of red thread, wide sleeves with silver wave and raindrop embroidery, a long black over-robe, a black sash knotted in a neat loop at the left hip with the bone abacus, a bronze bell and a blue jade coin hung from it. Hands and objects: the right wrist lifted wearing the jingling bracelet; the left hand hovers over a small balance; a slim sword hangs at her hip in a dark lacquered scabbard. Power: a soft aura of blue-white Water qi and pale silver Metal motes shimmers round her wrist and chimes with it. Background: a night market stall, lanterns, hanging goods in blue haze. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, each small bronze weight throwing a golden spark, a cool moon rim on her cheek. Expression: shrewd, proud, quietly greedy for the next coin.

people.imagined: Sorting pebbles at the mine, a pebble tucked in her cheek that she thinks no one has noticed.
people.subject: The moment: in a mine shed she sorts small pebbles on a tray, one cheek bulging round like a hamster's with a pebble held in her mouth, trying to look innocent. Face: most important, the one round bulging cheek with a pebble hidden in it. A round, tanned, innocent-looking face; wide, sly brown eyes with thick dark lashes giving them a solemn look; thin brows; a button nose; closed lips; a pale line of dust across the forehead. Hair: black, in two small buns tied with plain brown thread, a loose strand between them, a slim silver hairpin in each. Body: small, round-shouldered, stooping over the tray with elbows on the table, ready to swallow in a hurry. Clothing: a graceful robe of black silk with a storm-violet sheen, sleeves rolled, three crossed collars, a long black over-robe with a silver raindrop border, a dark sash with a bronze bell and a grey jade pebble. Hands and objects: both hands on a tray of sorted small pebbles in rows, one finger on a pale flower-shaped pebble; beside the tray a small clay dish of rejected grey chipped pebbles. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword, its grip covered in shingled pale grey ray-skin, a smooth plain guard of grey iron, a scabbard of dark wood, a flat grey rain-flower pebble set in the pommel cap. Power: a faint aura of silver Metal qi and amber earth motes floats over the sorted stones like dust in a moonbeam. Background: a mine shed, a table, rain at a window, soft blue mist. Light: pale rainy moonlight from the window falling across the stones on the tray, each pebble a soft round highlight, a faint violet rim on her cheek. Expression: innocent, secretive, comic.

people.imagined: At the vault door, back to it, one hand on the latch which has twice come off in his hand. He wants to be taught Thunder.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone corridor he stands with his back flat against a heavy black iron door, holding up an iron latch that has come off in his hand for the second time, comically detached; he wants to be taught Thunder. Face: most important, an iron door latch lying loose in his raised hand, wrenched off, held up toward the viewer, and a smudge of rust on his thumb and chin. A square, dutiful, plain face; earnest dark anxious eyes; thick brows with a line of worry between them; a short nose; a pressed hopeful mouth. Hair: black, in a short neat topknot tied with black cord and a silver clasp, one stray strand sticking out. Body: broad and sturdy, pressing his back against the door as if holding it shut with his whole frame, heels together, chin tucked. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, wide sleeves with silver lightning embroidery at the cuffs, a long black over-robe, a dark sash with a bronze bell and a violet jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the loose latch, the left rests on the door; a slim sword in a plain dark scabbard hangs at his hip. Power: a soft aura of pale silver Metal qi with a few violet sparks of the Thunder he longs for jumping from the latch. Background: cold flagstones, a long vault passage fading into mist, one dim lamp on a bracket. Light: dim golden light from a single lamp at the upper left casting his long soft shadow up the iron door, a glint on the latch, a cold violet rim on his shoulder. Expression: earnest and a little embarrassed, a sheepish wish to be forgiven.

people.imagined: Pinning a paper to the Hall of Rules' door again, her jaw set. Ink on her left sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: pressing a folded paper against a dark timber door with one hand, up on tiptoe, jaw set, glaring; she is pinning a paper to the Hall of Rules' door again. Face: most important, a left sleeve smeared black with ink and a square, set jaw. A sharp, fair, determined face; bright, angry dark eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm tight mouth pressed white at the edges; a faint ink-fleck on the cheekbone. Hair: black, in a tight knot with a wooden pin and a dark-silver hairpin. Body: slim, upright, her arm raised and shoulder set in a deliberate, defiant stretch. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, wide sleeves with silver raindrop borders, the left sleeve black with ink, a long black over-robe, a dark sash with a bronze bell, a folded paper and a coil of string at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a blank folded paper pressed to the door with a small iron pin held between left finger and thumb. A well-made straight double-edged sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung across the back, its pewter guard and pale blue cord grip above the right shoulder. Power: a cold aura of blue-white Water qi with a thin edge of silver Metal ripples round her raised arm. Background: a dark timber door, silver rain, a blurred hall. Light: hard cold spirit-light from the upper left lying flat on the door, sharp shadows under the pin and the edge of the paper, a faint blue rim on her jaw. Expression: a defiant glare, lips pressed flat as she holds the paper to the door.

people.imagined: Eyes following other men's swords, ore-hauler's sloping shoulders, passing a note to the Thunder Hall.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a rainy yard with his eyes following a sword out of frame in a hungry, envious stare; he will pass a note to the Thunder Hall. Face: most important, heavy sloping ore-hauler's shoulders and a gaze fixed hard on a blade out of frame. A broad, bony, brown face; sharp, hungry, narrow eyes; heavy brows, one higher than the other; a flat nose; a thin tight mouth; a day's stubble on the lean jaw. Hair: black, in a rough short tail held by a plain strip of leather and a dark-silver pin, ore-road dust in it. Body: thick sloping shoulders and long arms, weight forward on the balls of his feet, fingers flexing as if to take the sword himself. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, a long black over-robe with silver lightning and raindrop borders, a dark sash with a bronze bell and a red jade bead. Hands and objects: the right hand on a plain sword hilt at his hip, the left holding a small folded paper he means to pass to the Thunder Hall. Power: a soft aura of white-silver Metal qi with a dull ember-red Fire glow at his fingertips, restless with wanting. Background: a rainy yard with a few blurred swordsmen, silver rain. Light: cool moonlit light from the upper left falling across the wet yard and gleaming along the distant blades, a pale rim on his jaw. Expression: a tight envy at the corners of the mouth, the look of a man who wants what he is watching.

people.imagined: On the mule road, talking to his stick, a barley-sack hat on his head, counting his remaining trips. His old mule eats one sack in thirty.
people.subject: The moment: on a mule road at midday he leans on a knobbed stick and talks to it, a floppy hat of coarse barley-sack cloth on his head, counting his remaining trips; his old mule eats one sack in thirty. Face: most important, the floppy barley-sack hat, crudely stitched, and the thick knobbed walking stick held up to his mouth as he mutters to it. A very old, lined, brown face like old leather; small twinkling pale eyes; white bushy brows; a bulbous nose with fine veins; a toothless muttering mouth; white stubble and one long white hair from the left ear. Hair: white wisps below the hat. Body: bent, small and bandy-legged, stooping over the stick with knees slightly bent, bare brown ankles above his sandals. Clothing: a clean old robe of soft black silk with a faded storm-violet sheen, crossed collars, wide worn sleeves with a narrow silver raindrop border, a short black gauze rain-cloak, a rope belt tied with a loose bow and a small bronze bell, a barley husk on one sleeve. Hands and objects: a knobbed stick held in both hands with a row of notches cut along it; at the edge of the frame a mule's nose pushes in. Slung on his back a plain old straight sword with a worn grey cord grip in a scarred scabbard. Power: a faint warm haze of silver Metal qi and earth-gold motes round the stick, like dust on a sunny road. Background: a dirt mule road, barley sacks, misty hills. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the upper left showing the dust on the road and each fibre of the sacking hat, a gold rim on his white brows. Expression: muttering and wily, a toothless, affectionate cunning, as if the stick were an old friend who just gave good advice.

people.imagined: Teaching the drop-counting drill, a slow blink, a pebble bag at his hip. He drills his little sister harder than the rest.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a class of blurred children in a line, beside a hanging rain-chain, he gives the slow blink of the drop-counters while holding up a small smooth pebble; he drills his little sister harder than the rest. Face: most important, an unhurried slow blink, eyes half closed, and the small bag of pebbles at his hip. A calm, long, patient, pale-brown face; half-lidded steady dark eyes with faint creases at the corners from long watching; level brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; a small scar notching the chin. Hair: black, in a plain knot with a strip of grey cloth and a silver clasp, a few grey hairs at the temples. Body: lean, upright, composed, weight even on both feet, shoulders level. Clothing: layered robes of black silk and storm-violet gauze, three crossed collars, wide sleeves embroidered with silver raindrops in even rows, a long black over-robe, a dark sash with a cloth bag of pebbles, a bronze bell and a grey jade bead. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the pebble up between thumb and finger, the left rests on the pebble bag. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made slim jian, its grip wrapped in grey thread laid slowly in even rows, a round guard of old dull pewter, a scabbard of straw-pale split bamboo, a small leather pebble pouch tied to the strap. Power: a soft aura of pale silver Metal qi with faint ember-red and earth-gold threads, falling still as drops round the pebble. Background: a bronze rain-chain hanging, drops falling, blurred children in a line, silver mist. Light: soft moonlit light from the upper left on the hand holding the pebble so that it casts a round shadow on his palm, a cool rim on his temple. Expression: patient, firm, controlled.

people.imagined: Sweeping the founder's cistern, forearms like a stair-sweeper's, hem always wet, glad to have been sent back down.
people.subject: The moment: scrubbing the edge of the founder's stone cistern, her wet hem dragging, she looks up with a glad smile, happy to have been sent back down. Face: most important, strong forearms bare below rolled sleeves, and a hem dark and dripping. A round, ruddy, cheerful face; bright warm brown eyes; thick brows; a snub nose; a wide smile; chapped pink cheeks and a smear of lime-wash on the forehead. Hair: black, in a plain bun tied with a cord and a dark-silver pin, a short curl sticking out over each ear. Body: sturdy, strong-armed and rounded, kneeling on one knee by the rim with her back flat, a sweeper's solid ease. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, wet and dark at the hem, two crossed collars, sleeves rolled, a short black gauze rain-cape, a dark sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a stiff-bristled brush in the right hand, the left on the wet stone rim. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain slim jian with a round copper guard in a red-brown scabbard, the grip wrapped in rust-red cord. Power: a few small ember-red and silver motes rise from her warm hands and fade in the cistern's cool mist. Background: a stone cistern full of still water, an old tower wall, a bronze chain hanging down. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left, the water in the cistern throwing a rippling reflection across the stone and across her cheek. Expression: the open, unbothered pleasure of someone who likes honest work and has no wish to be anywhere grander.

people.imagined: In a rain cap embroidered with the family crest, a size too bright, hands that have never carried a bag, expecting the old tower to remember.
people.subject: The moment: at the grey gate of the old tower in the rain he stands with an arrogant, expectant air, hands clean and idle, a courier's blurred figure behind him, expecting the tower to remember his family. Face: most important, a straw rain-cap bound with brilliant red-gold embroidery of a small bird crest, too bright for the grey of the Tower. A smooth, handsome, spoiled face; haughty bright brown eyes; arched brows; a fine nose; a pouting expectant mouth with a faint gloss; unblemished skin. Hair: black and glossy, in a neat topknot under the cap with a fine silver hairpin. Body: slim, upright, soft, feet turned out, shoulders thrown back, hands held at his belt like a young lord at a feast. Clothing: a robe of the finest black silk with a storm-violet sheen, richer than any other junior's, two crossed collars, wide sleeves lined with a thin band of dark blue silk and embroidered with silver raindrops, a fine black gauze rain-cloak, a dark sash with a small bronze bell and a blue jade tassel, soft felt shoes. Hands and objects: both hands empty, delicate and clean, nails neatly pared; at his feet, out of frame, someone else's bag. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain slim jian a little too fine for a plain sword, its grip wrapped in new blue-grey silk, a round guard of polished steel with an unnicked rim, a scabbard of fresh black lacquer without a scratch, a stiff new family tassel. Power: a bright blue-white shimmer of Water qi lies lightly on his shoulders, pretty and thin. Background: the dark eaves of the tower above him, a thin curtain of silver rain, drifting mist. Light: soft cool spirit-light from the upper left finding the embroidery on the cap and making the thread glint gold and red. Expression: haughty, expectant, innocent.

people.imagined: Humming to the cisterns, hunched, gap-toothed, setting a straw hat on a peg for each elder who moved east.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone doorway at the end of the day he sets a straw hat carefully on a wooden peg, humming to the cisterns, one hat for each elder who moved east. Face: most important, a hunched back and a gap-toothed humming mouth. A very old, wrinkled, gentle face, brown and dry; small faded kind eyes; thin white brows; a bulbous nose with a drop of water at its tip; a mouth with two teeth; tiny hairs from the ears and nose. Hair: thin white wisps at the nape beneath a knit cap of undyed wool. Body: bent almost double, shrunken, the spine forward at nearly a right angle, long arms hanging with swollen knuckles. Clothing: the plain, clean, soft old robe of a tower servant, grey-black cotton with a thin storm-violet border at the cuffs and collar, a short black rain cape, a rope belt; plain, but tidy and cared for. Hands and objects: a straw hat in his hands; a row of straw hats hangs on pegs along the wall behind him; a wet scrubbing brush lies at his feet. Power: none, only a few pale blue motes of mist from the cistern drifting in the doorway. Background: a stone doorway, many straw hats on pegs, a cistern glimmering beyond. Light: soft silvery moonlight falling from the doorway from the upper left, a gleam of wet along the row of pegs. Expression: contented and humming, a faithful unhurried peace in the half-closed eyes.

people.imagined: Hair in a boatman's knot, a faded rope burn across her palm, chosen the rain burial in her first week.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty lake dock she stands straight beside a boat rope, palm held open to show a faded rope burn; she chose the rain burial in her first week. Face: most important, a pale, faded rope burn scar across her open palm held forward. A young, tanned, steady face; clear, brave, grey-brown eyes with short dark lashes; strong level brows; a short nose; a calm closed mouth; a small beauty spot at the corner of the left eye. Hair: black, tied in a boatman's knot high on the crown with a dark-silver hairpin. Body: lean, strong, balanced, feet planted in boatman's balance, knees slightly bent, as if the dock were moving. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of black silk with a faint storm-violet sheen, knotted up at the right hip, two crossed collars, sleeves held with twine, a short black gauze rain-cape, a wet-stained rope belt with a small bronze bell hanging loose. Hands and objects: the right palm open, the rope burn plain; the left holds a coil of rope. Past the right shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a plain short slim sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Power: a thin blue-white mist of Water qi curls up from the lake and wraps her ankles. Background: a grey lake dock, a small boat, silver mist. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left, a cool silver play on the water behind her lighting the pale line of the old burn. Expression: calm, resolute, unafraid.
